_doc: Personal hero specialties. Every named hero has one (heroes: exact hero names, also tavern heroes in buildings.json); a hero not listed anywhere gets one of its faction's specialties, picked by a stable checksum of its name (HeroSpecialties.for_hero). mods use the hero modifier keys (src/heroes/hero_modifiers.gd). growth adds its mods once per `every` levels after level 1, at most `max` times. formations: {formation id: {unlock, bonus_pct}} for the pre-battle formations (BattleOrders). Regenerate with tools/build_hero_specialties.py.
